citeinfo.title: Python Notebooks Used to Create HUC8-Level Synthetic Stream Network Reach Contributing Areas and Valley Bottoms in the Yukon and Kuskokwim River Basins, Alaska

descript.abstract: These notebooks and scripts process synthetic stream networks and DEMs to create unique reach contributing areas (uRCAs) and uRCA valley bottoms (uRCA VBs). The Python notebooks are designed to be run within ESRI ArcPro software and utilize the 'arcpy' module. The data were processed by region and in sections based on National Hydrography Dataset (NHD) Level 8 hydrologic units (HUC8) to reduce the computing workload, and therefore the scripts make use of a naming convention based on HUC8 codes within each regional geodatabase.
descript.purpose: These notebooks and scripts were created to support the US Fish and Wildlife Service (USFWS) Research Work Order (RWO) 230: "Freshwater Habitat Potential for Chinook Salmon in the Yukon and Kuskokwim River Basins, Alaska"
